verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows an interactive CLI installer for scaffolding new projects (phaser-docs-2/21) and a separate paid Scene Editor with an MCP 'agent' for human-in-the-loop coding assistance (phaser-docs-12/13/14/27/29) — neither documents a headless build/export command or CI pipeline usage. There is no mention of a 'phaser build' CLI, bundler config, or automated export pipeline suitable for CI. Missing for 10: documented headless build/export CLI command, CI integration example, evidence that game export doesn't require the GUI editor.
